subject: Unified Kaneo + Kanboard Work Management GUI and post-hardware-audit reconciliation
mandatory_constraints: Kaneo and Kanboard SHALL share one provider-neutral top-level Work Management GUI surface.
Provider identity SHALL remain projection metadata and SHALL NOT replace canonical work-item identity.
The GUI SHALL NOT become authorization, workflow, event, evidence, hardware-discovery or resource-admission authority.
CPU-only work-management workloads SHALL NOT require GPU/NPU discovery or accelerator leases.
Accelerator resources SHALL be requested only from explicit workload requirements and admitted by HRB.
The existing Accelerator Guard decision surface SHALL be reachable from the mandatory GUI navigation.
